translationRepairs: In the first year of Xianfeng he was made Plain White Mongol commander; when censors accused Qishan of slaughter in the Qinghai fan campaign, Sa Ying'a was sent to Xining to investigate.
In the first year of Xianfeng he was made Plain White Manchu Banner commander; when censors accused Qishan of slaughter in the Qinghai fan campaign, Sa Ying'a was sent to Xining to investigate.
s0122 reads 召授正白旗滿洲都統: the office is Manchu (滿洲) Plain White Banner commander, not Mongol. The proposed idiomatic replacement corrects that error without other changes.

In the first year of Xianfeng [1851], he was summoned and appointed Mongol commander of the Plain White Banner; joining Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Qishan in suppressing Qinghai fan bandits, censors impeached Qishan for indiscriminate killing, and Sa Ying'a was ordered to Xining to investigate.

In the first year of Xianfeng [1851], he was summoned and appointed Manchu commander of the Plain White Banner; when Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Qishan was suppressing Qinghai fan bandits, censors impeached Qishan for indiscriminate killing, and Sa Ying'a was ordered to Xining to investigate.

s0122 has 滿洲都統, so Mongol is wrong; 會陝甘總督琦善剿青海番匪 marks the concurrent Qinghai campaign when censors impeached Qishan, not Sa Ying'a joining that campaign. The proposed Manchu wording and when-clause fix both errors accurately.
